class.name: SuperposReplicator
class.brief_description: Binds scene properties of one node to the canonical fields of one World object.
class.description: On the authority, captures bound properties of a target node into canonical publications of one World object; it can also project the current canonical image back onto the node. Bindings map field IDs to property paths: a property name or an indexed path such as [code]position:x[/code] (at most four names). Paths never come from the network. [method capture_dirty] publishes only fields marked with [method mark_dirty]. [method capture_changes] is automatic dirty tracking: it reads every bound property once, encodes the values with the frozen schema, including quantization, and publishes only the fields whose encoded bytes changed, in one canonical publication. A change smaller than a quantized field's step therefore publishes nothing. With [member automatic_capture] enabled the node runs [method capture_changes] every [member capture_interval] physics frames while it is inside the tree. Capture runs once per object, never once per interested peer; [SuperposReplicationServer] fans the publication out. Getters and setters may free the node, its target or the Session: every step revalidates the binding and reports an interrupted capture or projection instead of touching freed state. Projection is sequential, not atomic. Leaving the tree clears the binding. [codeblock] var replicator := SuperposReplicator.new() body.add_child(replicator) replicator.bind_schema(world, body, handle, schema) # field names are property paths replicator.automatic_capture = true [/codeblock]

method.name: bind_fields
method.description: Binds up to 64 field IDs (keys) to property paths of [param target] (values). Every field must exist in the object's frozen schema, and no path may equal or contain another. No getter, setter or script runs while binding. Returns [constant ERR_ALREADY_IN_USE] while bound.

method.name: bind_schema
method.description: Declarative binding: maps every field of [param schema] to the property path in its [member SuperposField.field_name]. [param schema] must be the registered schema of the object (same schema ID), otherwise returns [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER].

method.name: capture_changes
method.description: Reads every bound property and publishes the fields whose encoded value changed. Returns [code]error[/code], [code]status[/code] ([code]completed[/code], [code]interrupted[/code] or [code]failed[/code]), [code]completed_fields[/code], [code]changed_fields[/code] and [code]source_revision[/code]. Nothing is published when nothing changed. A value of the wrong type or outside a quantized field's range fails without publishing.

method.name: capture_dirty
method.description: Publishes the fields marked with [method mark_dirty] in one canonical publication. Marks raised during the capture survive it; a failed capture restores the marks.

method.name: clear_binding
method.description: Ends the binding immediately, even inside a getter or setter. Later work of the old binding is rejected.

method.name: mark_all_dirty
method.description: Marks every bound field for the next [method capture_dirty].

method.name: mark_dirty
method.description: Marks one bound field for the next [method capture_dirty]. Returns [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST] for an unbound field.

method.name: project_current
method.description: Applies the object's current canonical image to the bound properties through ordinary setters, in field order, and reports the exact applied prefix when interrupted.

method.name: read_binding
method.description: Returns [code]error[/code] and, while bound, [code]handle[/code], [code]binding_generation[/code], [code]incarnation[/code], [code]field_count[/code] and [code]dirty_mask[/code]. Always includes the capture settings and counters: [code skip-lint]automatic_capture[/code], [code skip-lint]capture_interval[/code], [code]captures[/code], [code]published_captures[/code], [code]unchanged_captures[/code], [code]failed_captures[/code] and [code]last_capture_error[/code].

members.member: When enabled, [method capture_changes] runs every [member capture_interval] physics frames while the node is inside the tree and bound.
Physics frames between automatic captures, from 1 to 600.
